ADVANCED_METRICS_NOT_ACQUIRED.requested: advanced game metrics and statistics (Statcast, wOBA/xwOBA, exit velocity, pitch-level data, win probability added, etc.)
ADVANCED_METRICS_NOT_ACQUIRED.outcome: NOT OBTAINABLE through any rail available to this session.
ADVANCED_METRICS_NOT_ACQUIRED.why: Advanced metrics live inside pages, not in titles. Titles can carry a final score; they cannot carry a box score. Every host that serves this data is denied by the organisation's egress policy: baseballsavant/mlb.com, baseball-reference.com, fangraphs, espn.com, foxsports.com, rotowire.com, covers.com, plaintextsports.com. WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED on all of them. raw.githubusercontent.com IS reachable, but the community datasets that mirror this data (sportsdataverse/baseballr-data) carry no MLB schedule and nothing past 2024.
ADVANCED_METRICS_NOT_ACQUIRED.what_i_will_not_do: Reconstruct advanced metrics from search-summary prose. A summariser's account of a box score is exactly the unattributable evidence class that produced tonight's echo error and this repo's standing R1 rule. Inventing plausible Statcast figures would be worse than reporting none.
what_would_unblock_it: an egress-policy grant for baseballsavant.mlb.com or baseball-reference.com
